prompt: In a flat vector illustration, a snowy town square features six distinct elements arranged across the foreground. On the left stands a woman in a blue coat holding a red mug. To the right of the fountain, a child in a yellow jacket looks at a black cat perched on a bench. The black cat sits calmly, observing the scene. The woman in the blue coat is handing a small treat to the golden retriever, creating a gentle interaction between them. Meanwhile, the man in the green hat gestures toward the fountain, directing the attention of the child in the yellow jacket, who follows his gaze intently. The snow covers the ground uniformly, with simple geometric shapes representing distant buildings. There is no sun visible in the sky, keeping the focus entirely on the figures and their immediate surroundings. The composition relies on clean lines and solid colors without gradients or shadows, emphasizing the stylized nature of the artwork. Each character is easily distinguishable by their unique clothing color or animal species, ensuring clarity in the visual narrative. The spatial arrangement balances the left and right sides with the central fountain acting as an anchor point for the interactions occurring around it.
